name: Law2_ScGeom_MortarPhys_Lourenco
description:
Material law for mortar layer according to [Lourenco1994]_. The contact behaves elastic until brittle failure when reaching strength envelope. The envelope has three parts.

Tensile with condition $\sigma_N-f_t$.

Shear part with Mohr-Coulomb condition...
